Good to know.

[ 01 ]How do I book?

Send your preferred date, session length, crew size, and equipment needs. Peter confirms availability and a quote directly. Half-day, full-day, multi-day, and recurring sessions can be discussed.

[ 02 ]Can I bring my own gear and crew?

Yes. Bring your cameras, lighting, and team. The full space is yours during your confirmed session. Include your crew size and any special setup requirements in your inquiry.

[ 03 ]What about parking and access?

Parking is adjacent to the loft at 1409 Botham Jean Blvd, with street parking nearby. Let us know if you have a large crew or production vehicle so access can be coordinated.

[ 04 ]What are the rates and cancellation terms?

Rates, equipment availability, and booking and cancellation terms are confirmed in writing with your quote. Sending an inquiry does not reserve a date or take payment.
